mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate signals accommodative monetary policy that reduces equity discount rates, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days without regime dependence.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in unemployment rate below 4.0% indicates labor market tightening that boosts corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE falls below 4.0%, or Rank IC is below 0.02 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts and retail sales signals robust consumer demand that supports corporate revenue growth, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS rise, or interaction term Rank IC is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: In early-cycle expansion, rising industrial production indicates strengthening manufacturing activity that correlates with positive equity returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of early-cycle expansion periods with rising INDPRO, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year window.
